messages:
Avery (People Ops): quick question — i paid for a lounge + wifi for my partner on the same booking. can i claim the portion i used?
Ravi (Engineer): we had to do that once when flight got rebooked. finance made me add two lines to the expense, fyi.
Tess (Sales): policy is employee-only unless partner is traveling for a business reason and preapproved by manager/people ops. otherwise personal.
Lian (Finance): correct. companion costs are non-reimbursable without prior approval. if merchant gives one receipt you should: 1) upload original receipt; 2) create two expense lines with amounts split; 3) add a short note explaining the split; 4) attach manager approval or add manager as approver on the request. handwritten splits are acceptable if legible, but merchant split is preferred.
ExpenseBot: NOTE — "LOUNGE ACCESS" and "IN-FLIGHT WIFI" reimbursable only for Redwood employees or with documented preapproval. Provide receipts + manager approval.
Avery (People Ops): what about seat upgrades that come with lounge access included?
Lian (Finance): treat upgrades case-by-case. if the upgrade is for a business reason (e.g., needed for work-related rest before a critical all-day meeting) get manager preapproval. attach trip justification in the expense.
Ravi (Engineer): currency/tax detail: my booking was in GBP. do i need to add conversion evidence?
Lian (Finance): attach the card statement or merchant receipt. we convert on transaction date. if VAT is on the receipt and reclaimable, finance will handle reclaim for the reimbursable portion only. companion VAT is not reclaimable by the company.
Tess (Sales): wifi used for doing client demo mid-flight — eligible?
Lian (Finance): yes, wifi can be reimbursed when used for documented business activity. include a one-line justification (client name, short activity) and manager acknowledgement. we don't require raw logs, just a plausible explanation.
Avery (People Ops): TL;DR: employee items ok, companion items not ok without preapproval. single receipt -> upload original, split into two lines, label companion as personal, include manager approval. name attachments like: lastname_ts_receipt.jpg and lastname_ts_manager_ok.png
Ravi (Engineer): submitting now. thanks! :thumbsup:
